7.4.title: My Fair Feline / Double Trouble Talk / Half-Baked Alaska

7.5.desc: In this fairy tale, Garfield wins the hand of a Princess for Jon. / Wade decides to shell himself up because of all that is scary about the world. / Sidney the dinosaur comes out of a cave and decided the best way to take over the world is to paint himself pink and start a children's show but, Garfield won't have that.
7.5.title: Puss in High Tops / Egg Over Easy: Part 1 / The Beast from Beyond

7.6.desc: Model Behavior: Supermodel Heather keeps leading Jon on, while only wanting Garfield for herself. Egg Over Easy 2: Wade realizes you can't just escape from the world by closing yourself off and unshells himself. Another Ant Episode: The ants are back and Jon calls Mr. Crater, a bug exterminator, for this musical episode. Song: "We Are Back."
7.6.title: Model Behavior / Egg Over Easy - Part 2 / Another Ant Episode

7.7.desc: Penelope is back singing why she loves Garfield. / "the Guy of My Dreams." Discount Of Monty Cristo: Aloysius Pig is back trying to cut the budget of the show. / Esmeralda is sent from doggy wish Central to fulfill Odie's wish to go to the Doggie Ball.
7.7.title: The Guy of Her Dreams / The Discount of Monte Cristo / The Fairy Dogmother

7.8.desc: Floyd quits the show and leases his hole to a comic mouse who does a whole special revolving around Garfield sleeping. / A psychiatrist comes to the farm and falls victim to Orson's overactive imagination. / A musical episode for Garfield's birthday set to the tune of '12 Days of Christmas'.
7.8.title: The Stand-Up Mouse / Daydream Doctor / Happy Garfield Day

7.9.desc: In Sit on It, Garfield learns from the Cat Channel that he should sit on things humans want to read, so he takes over Jon's Spanish book. In Kiddie Korner, a pig from the network tells the US Acres crew to do nursery rhymes instead of Dr. Zhivago, but every rhyme they try is unsuitable for children. In Brainwave Broadcast, Garfield demonstrates the "telepathovisionator," which allows the audience to hear his thoughts.
7.9.title: Sit on It / Kiddy Korner / Brainwave Broadcast

abronxtail.desc: Bronx accidentally winds up in Pennsylvania by train. He is spotted and hunted down by frightened residents. His new friend, an Amish boy, tries to send him back to New York after sundown.
abronxtail.title: A Bronx Tail

alighthouseintheseaoftime.desc: While the Clan opposes MacBeth's attempt to steal the Scrolls of Merlin, Hudson gets some help from a new and highly literate friend.
alighthouseintheseaoftime.title: A Lighthouse in the Sea of Time

andjusticeforall.desc: The Gargoyles try to stop a jewel store burglary, but the gargoyles end up the main suspects when the thieves escape. The police capture Goliath, and he asks the others not to break him out.
andjusticeforall.title: And Justice for All

angelsinthenight.desc: The Gargoyles are tricked while attempting to rescue a child in a partially built building. Angela and Bronx are too late to save the rest of the clan as the sun comes up.
angelsinthenight.title: Angels in the Night

avalonpart1.desc: An adult Tom, whom Goliath and his clan befriended 1,000 years ago when he was a child, arrives in Manhattan. He needs help on the isle of Avalon. Goliath, Elisa, and Bronx go with him to help and see what happened to the Gargoyle eggs.
avalonpart1.title: Avalon: Part 1

avalonpart2.desc: Goliath and Elisa meet with Princess Katherine and the Magus. They're under attack from the Archmage, Demona, MacBeth, and the Weird Sisters. Elisa knows they'll need more allies in the up coming fight: She goes to awake King Arthur.
avalonpart2.title: Avalon: Part 2

avalonpart3.desc: The Sleeping King has been awakened. Goliath and all his allies fight the Archmage, Demona, MacBeth and three of Oberon's children.
avalonpart3.title: Avalon: Part 3

awakeningpart1.desc: Detective Elisa Maza arrives on scene at a huge battle on a skyscraper with an old Scottish castle that has been recently installed. The castle's history is revealed: It is the home of the mythical Gargoyles.
awakeningpart1.title: Awakening: Part 1

awakeningpart2.desc: In the past, Goliath returns to the castle to find most of his clan have been destroyed. The Magus casts a spell on the remaining Gargoyles and puts them into a thousand year sleep. After that, they wake up in modern Manhattan.
awakeningpart2.title: Awakening: Part 2

awakeningpart3.desc: Elisa encounters the Gargoyles. She offers to help them understand their new environment. Elisa and Goliath agree to meet the next night so she can show him the city. Meanwhile the other gargoyles do their own exploring.
awakeningpart3.title: Awakening: Part 3

awakeningpart4.desc: Goliath and Elisa are attacked in the park. They manage to escape, but Elisa has to protect the wounded Goliath during the day. Xanatos then reunites the clan with someone they thought they had lost.
awakeningpart4.title: Awakening: Part 4

awakeningpart5.desc: The Gargoyles retrieve Xanatos's data. When they return, Goliath meets with Elisa who gives him the real story on the data. Goliath informs the others, which sets up a battle, and then learns more about the last battle at Castle Wyvern.
awakeningpart5.title: Awakening: Part 5

broadwaygoeshollywood.desc: Fox makes a movie, thinking it will help the Gargoyles' acceptance within humanity. She and Broadway go to Hollywood. While Jackal and Hyena threaten to ruin their plans.
broadwaygoeshollywood.title: Broadway Goes to Hollywood

broadwaygoestohollywood.desc: Fox makes a movie, thinking it will help the Gargoyles' acceptance within humanity. She and Broadway go to Hollywood. While Jackal and Hyena threaten to ruin their plans.
broadwaygoestohollywood.title: Broadway Goes to Hollywood

bushido.desc: The world tour continues in Japan where they encounter a whole clan of Gargoyles. Unlike Goliath's clan, these Gargoyles are know in the village they protect. But one person wants to expose the Gargoyles to the entire world.
bushido.title: Bushido

cityofstonepart1.desc: Demona promises to make Xanatos immortal by sharing a spell that has kept her young for the past few centuries. But she lied and casts a different spell. Flashbacks reveal Demona's past and her relationship with Macbeth.
cityofstonepart1.title: City of Stone: Part 1

cityofstonepart2.desc: The Gargoyles find a statue of Elisa in the Tower, as they explore the city they find more statues. They need to find out what happened. Xanatos tries stops the broadcast. Goliath and Xanatos must work together to save the city.
cityofstonepart2.title: City of Stone: Part 2

cityofstonepart3.desc: In the past, Macbeth and Demona agree to help each other. The bargain is sealed with a magical pact by the Weird Sisters. In the present, Manhattan awakens with no knowledge of what transpired. Xanatos comes up with a plan.
cityofstonepart3.title: City of Stone: Part 3

cityofstonepart4.desc: How Macbeth and Demona went from allies to bitter enemies is finally revealed. Xanatos and the Gargoyles have a plan to save the city but the personal battle between Macbeth and Demona may interfere with their chances of success.
cityofstonepart4.title: City of Stone: Part 4

cloudfathers.desc: The World Tourists arrive at Elisa's sister school in Arizona and must help her and their father help the mystic Coyote from being captured by Xanatos.
cloudfathers.title: Cloud Fathers

deadlyforce.desc: When Broadway accidentally shoots Elisa, he is grief stricken while Goliath and police hunt for a gangster they think is the culprit.
deadlyforce.title: Deadly Force

doublejeopardy.desc: Elisa is almost run off the road by something resembling Goliath. The culprit leads to a project sponsored by Xanatos. Goliath, Xanatos and Sevarius face a creation that seems to have inherited their best characteristics.
doublejeopardy.title: Double Jeopardy

entermacbeth.desc: A mysterious man with considerable experience with Gargoyles offers his services to remove the clan from the castle.
entermacbeth.title: Enter Macbeth

eyeofthebeholder.desc: Xanatos proposes to Fox, he gives her the Eye of Odin as an engagement gift. The Eye causes Fox to undergo a transformation, Xanatos tries to help her on his own, but when that fails, he tries to manipulate the Gargoyles.
eyeofthebeholder.title: Eye of the Beholder

eyeofthestorm.desc: The travelers end up in the arctic circle where a man tries to trade them blankets, other survival items for the Eye of Odin. They soon realize it really is Odin, Goliath uses the Eye to fight Odin. The power soon goes to Goliath's head.
eyeofthestorm.title: Eye of the Storm

foritmaycometrue.desc: After being knocked out in a battle, Goliath dreams that he is a human married to Elisa.
foritmaycometrue.title: For It May Come True

futuretense.desc: Goliath attempts to use the Phoenix Gate to travel through time to get to Manhattan. He arrives to find Demona has joined the clan, and is married to Brooklyn. Xanatos has the Gargoyles on the run, but finds unexpected allies.
futuretense.title: Future Tense

generations.desc: Angela still believes that Demona can be redeemed. Goliath and Brooklyn, try to convince her that her mother will never change.
generations.title: Generations

genesisundone.desc: The Clone Clan is deteriorating. Goliath must decide whether to work together with Sevarius or to leave them to die.
genesisundone.title: Genesis Undone

golem.desc: The World Tourists arrive in Prague to find Halcyon Renard taking desperate measures to preserve his life with the use of a golem over the objections of its young controller.
golem.title: Golem

grief.desc: The World Tourers come to Egypt where they find a grieving Emir plotting to enslave the death god, Anubis.
grief.title: Grief

herbrotherskeeper.desc: While Elisa's brother considers working for Xanatos against her advice, Jackal and Hyena plot to strike against the billionaire.
herbrotherskeeper.title: Her Brother's Keeper

heritage.desc: The world tour continues on Queen Florence Island off the west coast of Canada where the group encounters a sea monster that separates them. Goliath and Angela encounter some Gargoyles, and Elisa meets with the locals.
heritage.title: Heritage

highnoon.desc: The clan is attacked by an inexplicable alliance of Demona, Macbeth, and Coldstone.
highnoon.title: High Noon

huntersmoonpart1.desc: Elisa is temporarily assigned a new partner and get switched to day shift. She asks the gargoyles to watch over some warehouses the thieves might try to hit next. Hunters appear and attack the gargoyles.
huntersmoonpart1.title: Hunter's Moon: Part 1

huntersmoonpart2.desc: Elisa is temporarily assigned a new partner and get switched to day shift. She asks the gargoyles to watch over some warehouses the thieves might try to hit next. Hunters appear and attack the gargoyles.
huntersmoonpart2.title: Hunter's Moon: Part 1

huntersmoonpart3.desc: Elisa is temporarily assigned a new partner and get switched to day shift. She asks the gargoyles to watch over some warehouses the thieves might try to hit next. Hunters appear and attack the gargoyles.
huntersmoonpart3.title: Hunter's Moon: Part 1

illmetbymoonlight.desc: The World Tourists return to Avalon in time to help the island's clan face the return of the Fairy Lord Oberon.
illmetbymoonlight.title: Ill Met by Moonlight

kingdom.desc: As Brooklyn struggles with his leadership duties in Goliath's absence, Fang of the Mutates seizes power in their underground home.
kingdom.title: Kingdom

leaderofthepack.desc: The Pack are freed from prison by Coyote and plot to strike against the Manhattan Clan.
leaderofthepack.title: Leader of the Pack

legion.desc: Coldstone returns. They soon learn Coldstone is not just one gargoyle, he is a combination of three distinct gargoyles. They all need help against a menace that fights from within.
legion.title: Legion

longwaytomorning.desc: While being pursued by Demona, Hudson keeps a wounded Goliath's spirits up with memories of their battle with the Archmage.
longwaytomorning.title: Long Way to Morning

markofthepanther.desc: Goliath, Angela, Elisa, and Bronx, arrive in Africa and meet Elisa's Mom. The tension between Goliath and Angela intensifies. The Gargoyles, Elisa, and her mother become involved in a tribal curse.
markofthepanther.title: Mark of the Panther

metamorphosis.desc: A number of victims, including Elisa's brother, are turned into winged animal people by Dr. Anton Sevarius and they think the Manhattan Clan shares responsibility.
metamorphosis.title: Metamorphosis

mia.desc: The World Tourists come to Britain only to be accosted by English gargoyles who blame Goliath for the disappearance of a clanmate in World War II.
mia.title: M.I.A.

monsters.desc: The adventurers tour continues at Loch Ness. Angela is captured by a familiar enemy, and some personal history is revealed.
monsters.title: Monsters

outfoxed.desc: Halcyn Renard's company finishes a new airship, Fortress II. Fearing Xanatos might try to sabotage it, Goliath goes to the ship to make sure nothing happens.
outfoxed.title: Outfoxed

pendragon.desc: King Arthur, Griff and the Manhattan Clan battle against Macbeth for possession of the ancient sword, Excalibur.
pendragon.title: Pendragon

possession.desc: To help Coldstone, Xanatos arranges for the two consciousnesses to temporarily possess Broadway and Angela respectively, only to have the third malevolent one secretly seize control of Brooklyn.
possession.title: Possession

protection.desc: Elisa seems to be running a protection racket for some reason.
protection.title: Protection

ransom.desc: Alex is abducted, and the kidnappers foolishly demand a Gargoyle as a ransom.
ransom.title: Ransom

reawakening.desc: A dead gargoyle of the Wyvern Clan is brought back to life by Xanatos and Demona as a cyborg.
reawakening.title: Reawakening

revelations.desc: Matt Bluestone finally confronts a member of the Illuminate who offers him membership if he delivers to them one of the gargoyles his partner is hiding.
revelations.title: Revelations

runaways.desc: Brooklyn feels sidelined by the clan, he makes friends with a group of young runaways, while Goliath and Eliza search for him.
runaways.title: Runaways

sanctuary.desc: In Paris, Elisa spots Macbeth, he's about to be married. Elisa recognizes his bride-to-be, and realizes the groom has to learn about his future wife's secret before it's too late.
sanctuary.title: Sanctuary

seeingisntbelieving.desc: Proteus has escaped New Olympus and come to New York, with Taurus in pursuit.
seeingisntbelieving.title: Seeing Isn't Believing

sentinel.desc: The world tour continues on Easter Island. Elisa falls asleep as Goliath and Angela explore the island. Elisa awakens and cannot remember who she is and worse she does not recall the gargoyles. Goliath tries to help her regain her memory.
sentinel.title: Sentinel

shadowsofthepast.desc: The World Tour begins at the original site of Castle Wyvern. There's more than old memories waiting for Goliath at his ancestral home.
shadowsofthepast.title: Shadows of the Past

temptation.desc: After an unpleasant encounter with humans, Brooklyn is swayed by Demona to work for her.
temptation.title: Temptation

thecage.desc: The Mutates, burning for revenge against the clan, return while Goliath decides to strong measures to find a cure for them with the unwilling aid of Dr. Sevarius.
thecage.title: The Cage

thedyingofthelight.desc: A group trying to promote tolerance between humans and Gargoyles are attacked. Hudson starts to have problems with his vision.
thedyingofthelight.title: The Dying of the Light

theedge.desc: Elisa gets a new partner. Xanatos donates the Eye of Odin to a museum to improve his public image. The Eye is stolen by something or someone resembling a Gargoyle.
theedge.title: The Edge

thegatheringpart1.desc: As Oberon gathers his children, the Fairy Lord searches for Puck in Manhattan and finds far more at the Xanatos residence.
thegatheringpart1.title: The Gathering: Part 1

thegatheringpart2.desc: As Oberon fights the Xanatos family to take their son to Avalon, the Manhattan Clan decides to oppose the Fairy Lords themselves.
thegatheringpart2.title: The Gathering: Part 2

thegreen.desc: The World Tourists arrive in a rainforest and find a gargoyle clan fighting furiously to defend it with the help of magic crystals that keep them from turning into stone during the day.
thegreen.title: The Green

thehoundofulster.desc: Arriving in Ireland, the World Tourists are imprisoned and tortured by a paranoid banshee while Bronx meets a native wastrel who has a hidden heroic past and destiny of his own.
thehoundofulster.title: The Hound of Ulster

thejourney.desc: With the existence of the Gargoyles revealed to the world, a hate group calling themselves "The Quarrymen" emerges determined to wipe them all out.
thejourney.title: The Journey

themirror.desc: Demona gets a hold of Titania's mirror. She uses it to summon Puck, one of Oberon's children, who's also a trickster and grants her wishes but not in the way she expects.
themirror.title: The Mirror

thenewolympians.desc: Upon arriving at the hidden city of New Olympus, Elisa is arrested by the human hating populace.
thenewolympians.title: The New Olympians

theprice.desc: After managing tho beat MacBeth in a fight, the Gargoyles settle down for sleep. That night, all the Gargoyles awaken - except Hudson. They suspect MacBeth used magic on their comrade. The Gargoyles try to find a cure.
theprice.title: The Price

thereckoning.desc: When the Mahattan Clan captures Demona, they and the Mutates decide to be her permanent jailers, unaware that they are falling into an elaborate trap doing so.
thereckoning.title: The Reckoning

thesilverfalcon.desc: Elisa and Broadway investigate the disappearance of her new partner, Matt Bluestone.
thesilverfalcon.title: The Silver Falcon

thethrillofthehunt.desc: Lexington meets his TV idols, The Pack, only to have them lure him and Goliath into a deadly hunt as the prey.
thethrillofthehunt.title: The Thrill of the Hunt

toservemankind.desc: Goliath is brainwashed by the Illuminati, and sent out to kill a president.
toservemankind.title: To Serve Mankind

turf.desc: While the Trio fight each other to woo Angela, they all must pull together to stop Tomas Brode's war against Anthony Dracon with Elisa in the middle working undercover.
turf.title: Turf

upgrade.desc: While Goliath considers a new second in command, Xanatos and Fox manipulate the Clan and the Pack as pawns of a friendly game of wits.
upgrade.title: Upgrade

vendettas.desc: Wolf and his ghostly ancestor Hakon travel to Manhattan to get their revenge on the Gargoyles. While Goliath and Hudson fight them off, one other is seeking the Gargoyles, a person who has had numerous encounters with the Gargoyles.
vendettas.title: Vendettas

vows.desc: Xanatos asks Goliath to his best man at his wedding, he also arranges for Demona to be the maid of honor. Goliath reluctantly shows up at the wedding, Demona uses the Phoenix Gate to transport the wedding party to the past.
vows.title: Vows

walkabout.desc: The World Tourists team up with Dingo and Fox to stop an artificially intelligent machine mass undergoing a grey goo situation.
walkabout.title: Walkabout

1.1.desc: Rocko and Heffer join a health club. Rocko goes shopping to the mall with his new credit card.
1.1.title: No Pain, No Gain / Who Gives a Buck

1.10.desc: An avalanche traps Rocko, Heffer and the Bigheads in a cabin./Filburt takes his final exam at dental school, and Rocko is his patient.
1.10.title: Cabin Fever / Rinse and Spit

1.11.desc: Rocko and Spunky run to the local grocery store to take advantage of a big sale. Rocko gets the flu and must get cured before the big wrestling match the next night.
1.11.title: Rocko's Happy Sack / Flu-In-U-Enza

1.12.desc: Heffer invites Rocko over for dinner with his parents, and Rocko accidentally reveals a secret. / Heffer helps Rocko get into dating.
1.12.title: Who's for Dinner? / Love Spanked

1.13.desc: Spunky falls in love with a dirty mop / Rocko decides it's time to do his laundry
1.13.title: Clean Lovin' / Unbalanced Load

1.2.desc: Mrs. Bighead tries to seduce Rocko./Heffer is kicked out of his parents' house, forcing him to live with Rocko.
1.2.title: Leap Frogs / Bedfellows

1.3.desc: Rocko and Heffer have very different experiences while traveling by airplane. Rocko decides to give Spunky a bath, revealing a sitcom world hidden in his fur. Introduces the show within a show, Bloaty and Squirmy.
1.3.title: Jet Scream / Dirty Dog

1.4.desc: Rocko and Heffer try to makeover Rocko's house after Ed tries to tip his nephew, a city home inspector in a scheme to get rid of Rocko; After Rocko is pulled over because his gas cap is missing, he has to go back to driving school.
1.4.title: Keeping Up with the Bigheads / Skid Marks

1.5.desc: When his boss goes out of town, Rocko is left in charge of the store./Heffer chokes on a chicken rib cage at a Chokey Chicken restaurant and has an after-death experience with Peaches in "Heck".
1.5.title: Power Trip / To Heck and Back

1.6.desc: Rocko visits his uncle's cattle ranch where Heffer becomes one of the heard / Rocko tries to get his garbage to the curb in time for the garbage men to take it
1.6.title: The Good, the Bad and the Wallaby / Trash-o-Madness

1.7.desc: Rocko and Heffer go to a baseball game to catch a foul ball and get an autograph./Rocko and Heffer go to the movies.
1.7.title: Spitballs / Popcorn Pandemonium

1.8.desc: Rocko buys a cleaning machine from the television to help him clean his house / After being laid off, Rocko searches for a new job. He finds a job testing new products
1.8.title: A Sucker for the Suck-O-Matic / Canned

1.9.desc: Rocko and Heffer go to a carnival and learn the secret to winning a carnival game. Rocko and Spunky cool off on a hot summer day by spending a nice relaxing day at the beach, only it doesn't go as planned.
1.9.title: Carnival Knowledge / Sand in Your Navel

2.1.desc: Rocko discovers that the Bigheads have a son, and he sets off to find him and bring him back.
2.1.title: I Have No Son!

2.10.desc: Rocko frets over the state of his unkempt hair in anticipation for having his picture taken for the town newspaper./Mr. Bighead desires a bowling trophy.
2.10.title: Hair Licked / Gutter Balls

2.11.desc: Rocko has to raise money so he has a garage sale. He finds that his old belongings mean more to him than he thought and he can't sell anything. / A pesky bug (the Flecko) tries to keep Rocko awake.
2.11.title: Junk Junkies / Day of the Flecko

2.12.desc: Rocko has to deliver comic books over the snowy mountain. Heffer and Rocko decide to spend the extra time (and money) doing a little skiing. / Bev adopts Earl as her pet. Earl acts viciously to Ed but like a pussycat to Bev.
2.12.title: Snowballs / Frog's Best Friend

2.13.desc: Rocko feels very short until he does something very big./Rocko is competing in the Jack Hammer finals, but has a problem with his eyesight.
2.13.title: Short Story / Eyes Capades

2.2.desc: Rocko and Heffer try to fix the plumbing in Rocko's house. / While facing an appendectomy operation with Dr. Hutchison, Rocko has a crazy dream where he makes friends with Pinky, his appendix.
2.2.title: Pipe Dreams / Tickled Pinky

2.3.desc: Filburt realizes his dream of becoming a lounge singer / After writing a proposal for her sick husband's presentation, Mrs. Bighead is hired as an executive at Conglomo-O.
2.3.title: The Lounge Singer / She's the Toad

2.4.desc: Rocko must take Spunky to the vet after he eats a vitamin that can cause pets to explode / Rocko and Heffer go on a road trip to see Flemm Rock
2.4.title: Down the Hatch / Road Rash

2.5.desc: Rocko purchases a big screen television and Heffer loses his brain inside of it / Rocko's car is impounded which causes him to continually be late for work
2.5.title: Boob Tubed / Commuted Sentence

2.6.desc: When elves move in across the street, Rocko invites them and all of O-Town to a Christmas party.
2.6.title: Rocko's Modern Christmas

2.7.desc: Rocko, Heffer, and Filburt go camping, but find it less enjoyable than they expected / When Rocko is going to be deported, he marries Filburt in an attempt to stay in the country
2.7.title: Hut Sut Raw / Kiss Me, I'm Foreign

2.8.desc: Rocko and Heffer get stuck on a senior-singles cruise with Grandpa Wolfe which takes them into the Bermuda Triangle.
2.8.title: Cruisin'

2.9.desc: Filburt comes of age and must go to the islands to spawn. He doesn't want to, for fear of growing up. Heffer becomes a security guard and finds it isn't all he expected it to be, in fact, it's quite scary.
2.9.title: Born to Spawn / Uniform Behavior

3.1.desc: Rocko "birdsits" Filburt's problem bird, Tirdy, when Filburt is sick. The bird dies when Heffer sits on it and Rocko and Heffer panic. / Heffer uses his unusual burping talent to secure a place for his troop of Weasel Scouts at Astro Camp.
3.1.title: Bye, Bye Birdie / Belch of Destiny

3.10.desc: In order to get out of a contract with his network, cartoonist Ralph Bighead hires fans Rocko, Heffer, and Filburt to create a sure-fire failure of a series that, much to his dismay, becomes a success.
3.10.title: Wacky Delly

3.11.desc: The moment we've all been waiting for: Filbert overcomes his fear and decides to ask Doctor Hutchison to marry him. /Dr. Hutchinson beats Filbert to the punch and asks him to marry her.
3.11.title: The Big Question / The Big Answer

3.12.desc: In order to officially become an adult member of the Wolf Pack,Heffer must bring home an elk for dinner./Rocko's hygiene is under scrutiny after his "spinach tooth" is revealed nationwide during his accepance speech.
3.12.title: An Elk for Heffer / Scrubbin' Down Under

3.13.desc: O-Town begins a massive musical recycling campaign. /Rocko purchases a lonely food processor, Food Boy.
3.13.title: Zanzibar! / Fatal Contraption

3.2.desc: Rocko falls prey to the Chameleon Brother's latest scam: a trendy new cafe which features a rather interesting brew. / Heffer becomes the newest member of the Sausage Club and it's up to Rocko and Filburt to save him from nitrate-induced hysteria.
3.2.title: The Emperor's New Joe / Schnit-Heads

3.3.desc: Hessian and the potency of candy when Rocko and Heffer introduce him to the concept of trick-or-treating. / Something in a Hitchcock-ian vein: Rocko suspects Bev Bighead of foul play when Ed disappears mysteriously.
3.3.title: Sugar-Frosted Frights / Ed Is Dead: A Thriller!

3.4.desc: Rocko, Heffer, and Filburt set out for a day of fantastic fishing - but the fish have other plans!/Rocko sets out to make a video tape to send home to his parents.
3.4.title: Fish-N-Chumps / Camera Shy

3.5.desc: Bev Bighead mistakenly gets a nose through accidental surgery and enjoys all the new aromas she encounters - all but the smell of her husband Ed./After being passed up for a promotion at work for a younger man, Ed experiences a mid-life crisis.
3.5.title: Nothing to Sneeze At / Old Fogey Froggy

3.6.desc: Rocko's car dies, but is recusitated to win the O-Town rally with Heffer piloting the car in reverse./Rocko finds himself in the middle of a plan to get Ed Bighead's private stock of bugs off the menu and into the good life.
3.6.title: Manic Mechanic / Rocko's Happy Vermin

3.7.desc: While on a trip to Paris, Rocko tries to find and impress a female wallaby while Heffer gets chased by a crazy tour bus driver./Rocko tries to help Spunky lose weight he recently put on, while Bloaty and Squirmy travel to newly discovered lands due to his weight gain.
3.7.title: I See London, I See France / The Fatlands

3.8.desc: Filburt receives a horrible fortune from a Chinese fortune cookie just before he is to enter the Mega Spin./Rocko's kitchen is destroyed by a government satellite right before his big party. He and Heffer attend Home Show conventions.
3.8.title: Fortune Cookie / Dear John

3.9.desc: After a big fight, Rocko and Heffer find themselves guests on "The Nosey Show", a daytime TV talk show./Rocko is forced into a twelve-step self-help program in order to come to grips with his nail-biting problem.
3.9.title: Speaking Terms / Tooth and Nail

4.1.desc: Rocko wins two free tickets to a wrestling match from a radio show./Ed Bighead's sleepwalking problem, triggered by the memory of an early childhood trauma, spells high adventure for Rocko and Spunky!
4.1.title: With Friends Like These / Sailing the Seven Zzzz's

4.10.desc: Heffer and Filburt introduce Rocko to the all-American pastime of "Ding-Dong-Ditch."/Filburt, the obsessive collector of bird wigs, takes Rocko along for his biggest score: the wig of an American Balding Eagle!
4.10.title: Dumbells / Rug Birds

4.11.desc: Heffer and Filburt hypnotize Rocko into thinking he's a dog./Rocko, after unwittingly being recruited as Mrs. Wolfe's driving instructor, finds himself riding shotgun in a deadly game of chicken against the ultimate demolition derby car.
4.11.title: Hypno-Puppy Luv / Driving Mrs. Wolfe

4.12.desc: Heffer overdoses on Pasture Puffies and is rushed to the hospital./In the O-Town of the far-flung future, Gilbert and Norbert -- descendants of a now ancient Filburt -- discover the remains of an old banana.
4.12.title: Put to Pasture / Future Schlock

4.13.desc: The special plans for Rocko's first Thanksgiving go awry when the turkey's of O-Town escape and take refuge in Rocko's house./The residents of O-Town engage in an argument about the correct origin of the town.
4.13.title: Turkey Time / Floundering Fathers

4.2.desc: It's the ultimate April Fools Day in O-Town as Rocko, Filburt, and Heffer try their best practical jokes on one another./Filburt's impending fatherhood is jeopordized by the Easter Bunny's fiendishly clever Lamaze class egg ring.
4.2.title: Pranksters / From Here to Maternity

4.3.desc: Rocko is unjustly imprisoned in the O-Town dog pound and incensed by he squalid conditions /When Heffer lands a part time job as an assistant greenskeeper at a prestigious golf course, he finds himself embroiled in Ed Bighead's office politics.
4.3.title: Ed Good, Rocko Bad / Teed Off

4.4.desc: Heffer transforms Rocko from milquetoast to Terminator./Classic fairy tales take on a decidedly new twist when Rocko convinces Heffer to read to a sick Filburt from "The Really, Really Big Book of Fairy Tales."
4.4.title: Wimp on the Barbie / Yarnbenders

4.5.desc: After suffering some ribbing from Rocko and Filburt, Heffer decides to move out of his parents home and strike out on his own./Rocko and Heffer's visit to a fortune teller channels them into danger when the spirit of Mortimer Khan possesses Spunky.
4.5.title: Mama's Boy / Feisty Geist

4.6.desc: Rocko falls for Alicia, his new mail carrier, but his plan to give her a love letter goes awry when Heffer takes over her route while she's sick./Ed Bighead is promoted to an executive at Conglomo.
4.6.title: S.W.A.K. / Magic Meatball

4.7.desc: When a clown's truck breaks down in front of his house, Ed Bighead begins to lead a double life./Rocko's behind earns him a place among the beautiful people of the fashion world when he becomes the spokes-wallaby for "Wedgie Boy" undergarments.
4.7.title: Closet Clown / Seat to Stardom

4.8.desc: After stumbling upon Filburt's secret diary, Heffer and Rocko are convinced that Filburt is an alien./Flecko the fly files a lawsuit against Rocko after tripping on a rock in his house.
4.8.title: The High-Five of Doom / Fly Burgers

4.9.desc: Heffer moves in with Rocko./Despite his vow to never do anything crazy to impress a woman, Rocko takes up roller skating after he becomes smitten with Sheila, the Roller Derby Queen.
4.9.title: Heff in a Handbasket / Wallaby on Wheels
